stemMd: A writer states: "The wetland boardwalk protects plants while giving visitors a close view of the habitat." Which detail best supports both parts of that claim?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The boardwalk was opened on a Saturday.

options.label: B
options.textMd: Visitors can buy snacks at the entrance.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Its raised walkway keeps shoes above the vegetation, and viewing platforms overlook the pools.

options.label: D
options.textMd: The nearest city is forty kilometers away.

explanationMd: The claim has two parts, so the best evidence must address both. Raising the path protects plants from feet, while platforms provide a close view of the pools.

distractorRationale.a: An opening date supports neither habitat protection nor close viewing.
distractorRationale.b: Refreshments do not demonstrate either stated function.
distractorRationale.d: Distance does not show how the boardwalk achieves its purposes.
